_meta.scanner_caveat: The referential-integrity scanner has been WRONG more often than the codebase across this session (5 routes misclassified as missing because they live under router prefixes or in api.py; prefix-boundary and source-echo false positives). Treat every 'orphaned' finding as a HYPOTHESIS to verify against source, not a fact. Dispositions below were verified by grep + render pass + handler read.
_meta.kind_schema: Each orphaned_post_routes entry carries a 'kind' field. Direction 4 asks 'does anything call this' — but a POST route legitimately has no FRONTEND caller for three distinct reasons, and only one is a defect: ui_affordance (registered route for a UI surface that was never wired — visual-ledger decision, THE defect), headless_api (deliberate public API with no frontend caller — park as intentional), headless_ingest (write endpoint for external processes/agents — no frontend caller is correct). Also: parked (product call pending), dormant (registered + referenced under conditions), redundant (duplicate of another endpoint — delete candidate).
